title: fix(runtime): an addressed /automation/:ns/:name/(runs|trigger) under an unserved verb answers the automation domain, as its bare path does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_
Fixes #33026
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:独立服务器上,带命名空间地址的 `/automation/:ns/:name/runs`、`/automation/:ns/:name/trigger`、`/automation/trigger/:ns/:name` 收到不支持的方法时,改由自动化领域回答(与不带地址的同一路由一致),不再由传输层回答。
- 为什么改:同一路由因写法不同返回两种错误信封、两种 `Allow`;匿名调用者在带地址写法上拿到 405(暴露路由形状)而不是 401。
- 风险与回滚:只在调度器里多声明三条「领域决定所有方法」的路由;已服务的方法照旧;回滚即还原该 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` 新增的三行声明;`automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts` 的新行与命名空间假数据。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`,预期 57/57 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `registerAutomationRoutes` (`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`) declares three more patterns through `domainDecidesEveryVerb` (#24228's mechanism): GET `/automation/:ns/:name/runs`, POST `/automation/:ns/:name/trigger`, POST `/automation/trigger/:ns/:name`. These are the addressed shapes (ADR-0150 D5) of the bare rows that were already declared. A verb the router cannot route on them now reaches `dispatch()`, so the anonymous floor answers `401` and the domain's `automationRouteAllow` answers `405` with `Allow: GET` / `Allow: POST` in the dispatcher's envelope.
- Measured before the change, on a real Hono socket at `1e65a389`: `DELETE /api/v1/automation/crm/send_digest/runs` answered `405`, `Allow: GET, HEAD`, with an `error.details` envelope, for a signed-in and an anonymous caller alike. The bare `DELETE /api/v1/automation/send_digest/runs` answered the domain's `405 Allow: GET` (signed in) and `401` (anonymous). The domain itself was never at fault: dispatched directly, the addressed shapes already answer its `405` (`automation-addressed-route.test.ts`). The gap was only the transport declaration. No edit to `runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`.

## Tests

`automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts` (both prefixes):
- Added rows: DELETE / POST / PUT on `/automation/crm/send_digest/runs`, GET on `/automation/crm/send_digest/trigger` and GET on `/automation/trigger/crm/send_digest`. Each row has an anonymous `401` case and a signed-in domain `405` case.
- Added controls: a served POST on both addressed triggers runs the flow; GET and DELETE on `/automation/no_such_ns/send_digest/runs` answer the dispatcher's `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`.
- `crm` is installed through an ObjectQL registry double answering the holder table the address reads.

<details><summary>Ablation, one per declaration (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- Without `:ns/:name/runs`: `Tests 14 failed | 43 passed (57)`. The failures are every addressed `/runs` row on both prefixes, plus the no-namespace DELETE control.
- Without `:ns/:name/trigger`: `Tests 4 failed | 53 passed (57)`. The failures are the anonymous and signed-in GET on `/automation/crm/send_digest/trigger`, on both prefixes.
- Without `trigger/:ns/:name`: `Tests 4 failed | 53 passed (57)`. The failures are the anonymous and signed-in GET on `/automation/trigger/crm/send_digest`, on both prefixes.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Same behaviour on a `createHonoApp` host (catch-all): it already handed every verb to `dispatch()`. No change there.

## Verification

Readings at `9bdd492b`, the head before the last `origin/main` merge. That merge brought no change to the three files here.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: `Test Files 603 passed (603) / Tests 10934 passed | 19 skipped`.
- Direct dependents exercising the dispatcher on Hono: `@objectstack/http-conformance` test, `Test Files 20 passed / Tests 292 passed`. `@objectstack/client` `package-addressing.test.ts`, `83 passed`.
- `automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`: `57 passed (57)`.
- eslint on both touched `.ts` files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 67 run, reconciled with `--ran` (67 derived, 67 run). 65 exit 0. Two NOT MEASURED on prerequisites: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a full `pnpm build`; `check:type-check-debt`'s inner build never got the lock.

Final head `39826829` (merge of `origin/main`, which carries #33721 and #33844 in `packages/runtime`): the scoped re-check (closure build, runtime typecheck, the every-verb, addressed-route, contract-mounts, clone-mount and route-ledger suites) is NOT MEASURED. The shared verify lock was held by another worktree's run for over 27 minutes. CI's Test Core runs the package on this head.
